findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 3 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 3.1.1 2, 3.1.2 3, 3.2 2, 3.3.1 2, 3.3.2 3, 3.4 1, 3.4.1 2, 3.4.2 2, 3.5 4.

5-mark parts covering sketching and analysing a quadratic function, maximum/minimum by completing the square and the derivation of h and k, inverses on a restricted domain with domain and range, absolute value quadratic equations and inequalities, equations reducible to quadratics (substitution, rational, radical), and real-world problems. Every step and result was checked by computation (check3_long.py). No exponential equations; the book's printed slips (x^2 >= 4 chain, 'or' in Example 6, +2 - sqrt(1 - 0), (-3^2)) are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
